description: Works out the dates that matter for a damage charge: whether an Airbnb host asked in time, when the traveller's reply window closes, and the US credit card dispute deadline. Only uses dates the user gives (YYYY-MM-DD).

checkout_or_return_date.description: Checkout date for a stay or return date for a car, YYYY-MM-DD

country.description: AU for Australia, US for the United States. Defaults to the site that was called

platform.description: Who sent the bill, e.g. Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, Stayz, Hipcamp, Hertz, Sixt, Avis, Budget, Enterprise, Europcar, Turo, Zipcar, Outdoorsy, RVshare, Camplify, JUCY, Britz, Maui, a direct host

request_date.description: Date the damage request or bill arrived, YYYY-MM-DD

statement_date.description: US only: date of the card statement that first showed the charge, YYYY-MM-DD

name: check_deadlines
title: Damage claim deadlines
